<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 5.7pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3.7pt 5.7pt 0 0; text-align: justify">Item 5.02 Departure of Directors
or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers: Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><i>(b) Resignation of Chief Financial Officer</i></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">On September 21, 2026, Heidi Huntington, the Chief
Financial Officer of Feel the World Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;), notified the Company of her intent to resign from her position effective
as of the close of business on October 16, 2026. Ms. Huntington indicated that her decision to resign was made in order to pursue other
professional opportunities and was not the result of any disagreement with the Company on any matter, or relating to its operations, policies,
or practices.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><b><i>(c) Appointment of Chief Financial Officer</i></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">On October 16, 2026, the Company&#8217;s board of
directors (the &#8220;Board of Directors&#8221;) appointed Zachary Guzy as Chief Financial Officer of the Company, effective upon the
resignation of Ms. Huntington.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">Mr. Guzy brings broad financial and operational leadership experience across
e-commerce, consumer products, manufacturing, distribution, and international businesses. Most recently, he served as Chief Financial
Officer of Enthusiast Auto Holdings, a private-equity-backed e-commerce company. He also previously served as Chief Financial and Operations
Officer of mDesign Global and held senior finance leadership positions with TCP International Holdings and The Lubrizol Corporation.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">Mr. Guzy will receive an annual base salary of $290,000 and will be eligible
to participate in the Company&#8217;s annual bonus plan and in the Company&#8217;s equity compensation plans commensurate with all other
officers.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">There are no arrangements or understandings between Mr. Guzy and any other
persons pursuant to which he was selected as an officer, he has no family relationships with any of the Company&#8217;s directors or executive
officers, and he has no direct or indirect material interest in any transaction required to be disclosed pursuant to Item 404(a) of Regulation
S-K.&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>
